summary: UMC filed a Form 6-K containing two Taiwan MOPS-style announcements: a press-clarification dated 2026/10/07 denying commentary on a Chinatimes report projecting 2026 revenue growth near 21% and profit growth about 133%, and a notice dated 2026/10/13 that UMC will hold its Q3 2026 investor conference on 2026/10/28 at 17:00 via online teleconference to discuss quarterly financial and operating results. Neither item constitutes a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock are stated. Watch ordinary quarterly results and guidance rather than deal risk-arb.
